cohort: 150 women with postpartum sepsis (cases) and 500 women without sepsis (controls) from a larger cohort of 4200 postpartum women.
finding: Several factors were significantly associated with an increased risk of postpartum sepsis, including 3-6 antenatal visits, 4 or more vaginal assessments, home deliveries, preterm deliveries, gestational diabetes, lower abdominal pain, vaginal discharge, SpO2 level under 89%, and high blood glucose levels.
